purpose: Teach: 島田/町田/森山/前原/足立/平山/椎名/村田

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 島田部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the welcome party for Division Head Shimada organized.
lines.style: Efficient, clear-headed. Slight lift at the end—a task being delegated, not imposed. Voice steady as though checking off a mental list.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。町田課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll review the handover notes from Manager Machida.
lines.style: Affirmative, attentive. Quick acknowledgment with no pushback. The tone of someone who already knows what needs doing and is moving straight to it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 森山技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the project progress update from Technical Lead Moriyama.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. A measured pacing—each phrase given its weight. Slight pause before the action verb, as though confirming Kenji is ready.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前原広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review the monthly planning document from Maehara in PR.
lines.style: Prompt, reliable. No wasted words. The quiet confidence of someone who has heard the instruction and is already mentally moving to complete it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 足立顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule a meeting with Advisor Adachi.
lines.style: Clear directive delivered at an even pace. Slight formality in the phrasing—this is a higher-stakes item. Matter-of-fact but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。平山経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the year-end financial projections from Accounting ready.
lines.style: Affirming, controlled. The energy is steady—not eager, not reluctant. A professional confirming what he'll do and implicitly that he'll do it well.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 椎名人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's request the new employee training plan from HR—from Shiina.
lines.style: Initiating, clear. A touch of ownership in the phrasing. Not rushed, but purposeful—the director of a series of small, necessary actions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。村田法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Right. I'll ask Legal to review the new contracts for us.
lines.style: Closing statement. Brisk, final. The slight settling-in of tone that signals this is the last item on the list. Confident and matter-of-fact.
